episode_title: Attribution Is Dead. Now What? w/ Rand Fishkin, CEO & Co-Founder of SparkToro

real_qa.q: What percentage of Google searches resulted in zero clicks in 2024 compared to 2022?
real_qa.r: According to Rand Fishkin's research, 58% of Google searches ended without a click in 2024, up from 60% two years ago, now reaching 67 percent. This represents the fastest growth observed in the last 12 years since the research began around 2014 or 2015.

real_qa.q: Why is attribution broken in the zero click era according to SparkToro research?
real_qa.r: Attribution is broken because platforms like LinkedIn are hiding referral data for organic visits, and people consume content directly on platforms without clicking through. LinkedIn posts without links get greater reach, but you cannot see the influence in an attribution-friendly way. Additionally, AI tools keep 999 out of 1000 people on platform, and social networks keep 98-99 out of 100 users within their own ecosystem, making traditional click-based attribution impossible.
real_qa.requete: why attribution broken zero click era

real_qa.q: How did Reddit outperform LinkedIn for SparkToro's zero click search research engagement?
real_qa.r: Rand's zero click search research from June generated approximately 100,000 engagements on LinkedIn, tens of thousands on Threads, a few thousand on Twitter, and more than a million impressions on Reddit. While Reddit did not drive website clicks—with click-through rates at AI levels of one in a thousand—it attracted journalists and media coverage that increased brand visibility and search rankings.
real_qa.requete: Reddit zero click research million impressions SparkToro

real_qa.q: What is the organic-to-paid marketing influence ratio according to Rand Fishkin?
real_qa.r: Rand Fishkin believes organic marketing is still overwhelmingly more influential than paid, with an estimated 80-to-20 ratio of organic to paid influence. However, paid channels consistently receive credit for conversions that would have happened anyway, because attribution systems are designed to favor paid media over organic channels.
real_qa.requete: organic versus paid marketing influence ratio

real_qa.q: Why should marketers adopt short-form video as their primary creative practice in the zero click era?
real_qa.r: Short-form video is the biggest superpower for marketers today because nothing else captures attention like it, regardless of platform. YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Reddit video, and LinkedIn short videos crush traditional content formats. This is much more creative and human than optimizing snippets for Google rankings, and it requires deeper understanding of human psychology, persuasion, hooks, and attention with hyper-fast iteration cycles.
real_qa.requete: short form video marketing zero click era

guest.bio_context: Rand Fishkin is the CEO and co-founder of SparkToro, an audience research platform. He is also the author of Lost and Founder: A Painfully Honest Field Guide to the Startup World, and co-authored Zero Click Marketing with Amanda Natividad, which examines how brands must adapt as clicks decline from organic search. He also founded AlertMouse and Snackbar Studios, and previously conducted attribution research at Moz starting in 2014 or 2015.
